notes.title: Cliff Rockslide Takes on Cults, Cubes & Maybe Zombies!
notes.content:
Embrace investigative journalism and film the weird stuff with Cliff Rockslide! Brace yourselves for cults, zany neighbors, glowing cubes of questionable origin, and a possible zombie apocalypse. Butterfly Valley’s craziest newsman needs your camerawork!

Local News with Cliff Rockslide is breaking out of the streaming scene and landing on new consoles – that's right, PlayStation and Xbox! Mark your calendars for June 28th, because Cliff's quirky brand of journalism is about to take the world by storm.

[b]Here's what you can expect:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Cliff's Comedy Chaos:[/b] Buckle up for a story that'll have you snorting with laughter. Cliff's jokes are guaranteed to tickle your funny bone for days.
[*] [b]You're the Director![/b] Make key decisions, capture the juiciest footage, and become the mastermind behind the camera.
[*] [b]A Visual Experience Unlike Any Other:[/b] See the world through the cameraman's lens for a truly immersive storytelling adventure.
[*] [b]Welcome to Butterfly Valley:[/b] Get ready to explore this charming (and slightly strange) town alongside Cliff and its quirky residents.
[/list]
So dust off your microphones, hire your cameraperson, and get ready to hit the streets of Butterfly Valley! Remember folks: local news is global news!

[b]Local News with Cliff Rockslide will be available on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One and Xbox Series S/X starting June 28th.[/b]

[b]Local News with Cliff Rockslide on Steam[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2464030/Local_News_with_Cliff_Rockslide/

notes.title: Mythargia release on Nintendo Switch.
notes.content:
Is this cool or what! We release Mythargia now for Nintendo Switch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738637/636e3fc3b89723ee3929ce17c3c5eb19e48d88ed.png[/img]

[b]Lapland, Finland - May 31st, 2023[/b] - Spine-chilling retro adventure Mythargia release on Nintendo Switch. Prepare to embark on a spine-chilling retro adventure, as you uncover the mysteries of a mysterious abandoned island across two dimensions.

In Mythargia, you assume the role of a courageous journalist searching for the story of a lifetime. Explore the eerie island, solve challenging puzzles, and collect vital clues to piece together the dark history that haunts Mythargia. With atmospheric pixel art and haunting music, the game brings vintage 2D tricks into the Nintendo Switch.

Experience a unique storytelling journey as you cross the boundaries between dimensions, assisting islanders and unraveling their secrets. Beware of the dangers lurking in the shadows, as the island's supernatural beings and treacherous traps pose a constant threat to your survival.

Mythargia has captivated critics with its spine-chilling narrative and innovative blend of vintage aesthetics and modern gameplay. Now, Nintendo Switch players can immerse themselves in the gripping world of Mythargia, uncovering its mysteries and forging their path to the truth.

[b]Features and gameplay in a nutshell:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Travel between two dimensions to unlock the full story of the island.
[*] Unravel the dark and disturbing history behind abandoned island of Mythargia. 
[*] Face otherworldly beings as you navigate the island.
[*] Search for clues, read journals, and take photos to piece together the story of Mythargia.
[*] Haunting and spine-chilling story that will keep you engaged from start to finish.
[/list]

Get ready to embark on an unforgettable adventure when Mythargia releases on Nintendo Switch on May 31st, 2023. Visit the Nintendo eShop to embark on this hair-raising journey.

The game is developed by RunByCoffee, and published by Bonus Stage Publishing. 


Nintendo eShop: https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/mythargia-switch/

Press kit: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1d2rvAZ2GDd7Yvwp1r-eih2LFKieCzprX

For press inquiries and review keys, please contact: team@bonusstage.co

notes.title: Mythargia Update - Version: 1.1.0
notes.content:
Whew, it's one week after the release and the game is still working. This has been a memorable week for us. We asked you to report to us if you find bugs in the game. And just a note: THE BEAR TRAPS ARE A FEATURE, NOT A BUG.

Nevertheless, here's everything we have already fixed in this patch.

[list]
[b]New stuff added
[/b][*] New: Added "Point of No Return" sign to the sanitarium basement 2 evacuation door
[*] New: Added "alternative text" feature to character dialogues
[*] New: Native Linux support
[*] New: Randomly generated and placed bear traps (may be a joke, dunno...)

[b]Tweaks to audio
[/b][*] Audio fixes: Locker Room - Void - Level Inspecting file cabinet now gives journal entry sound 
[*] Audio fixes: Medical Ward - Room 4 - Writing journal entry plays writing audio only once
[*] Audio fixes: Meeting Rooms - Room 2 - Writing journal entry now plays writing audio only once
[*] Audio fixes: You should not yell at your mom when the bear traps get you. Focus!

[b]Text updates
[/b][*] Text fixes: Administrator's Office - Added missing sentence to alternative text prompt

[b]Minor fixes
[/b][*] Interaction fixes: Library - Fixed barred door's interaction icon location

[b]Damn bugs
[/b][*] Bug fixes: Articles Tab - The Islanders content 1 photo is now working when obtaining correct photo
[*] Bug fixes: Articles Tab - The Outsiders content 1 photo is now working when obtaining correct photo 
[*] Bug fixes: "Paparazzi" achievement fixed
[*] Bug fixes: Opening "pause menu" while hiding would allow player to start moving around map as invisible character
[*] Bug fixes: After map change flashlight would revert back to "normal state" even if player had UV mode enabled
[*] Bug fixes: After map change flashlight mode required to press "flashlight special button" twice

[b]Some changes 
[/b][*] Changes: You can now open "pause menu" while in hiding or climbing ladders
[*] Changes: If player is middle of teleporting to new a map or talking to NPC enemies will temporary freeze
[*] - Changes: Added extra achievements checks each time player opens "Character Menu"
[/list]

Have fun! We love you all.

notes.title: Losing your mind is not hard in the island of Mythargia
notes.content:
[h2]”No nyt jumalauta”[/h2]

...is a Finnish saying which represents the awe and wonder how a person feels when they get their vision back with new glasses or when they release a game. Roope and Michael released thus their first game and that’s the only thing they are capable of saying right now. The literal translation would be something along the lines of "well, now may god help us".

Finally the guys found a new word: [i]nonnih[/i], which is a traditional way of saying I’m feeling quite proud now.

And after a while of breathing, they told us the official statement:
[h3]Mythargia was made with the quantity of coffee cups that health officials warn you about. Now the game is here for you to enjoy.[/h3]

So go & get it while it's hot (the coffee cup I mean, the game will be downloaded while you get it because you have good brains and you'll buy the game now, immediately, thank you).
